method: Inventoried the named GitHub accounts, stars, repositories and public Lists.
Fetched and machine-screened 859 root READMEs in the 952-repository primary universe.
Separated forks, canonical upstreams, archived resources, prototypes and public operational resources.
Obtained an independent second-engineer review before live mutation.
Reviewed all 26 PKU-Alignment repositories and selected 22 after category and canonical corrections.
Verified every live GitHub List count after mutation.

exclusions.private_personal_repository_names: Excluded and not enumerated in this public bundle.

pku_alignment.reason: Project website duplicate of the aligner repository.
Localized derivative with no substantive root documentation.
Multimodal test-time reasoning repository without a safety-specific research focus.

exclusions.one_hop_repository_links: 3,436 links remain an unreviewed discovery queue and are not included here.

limitations: Repository state, licences and maintenance status can change after the snapshot date.
README screening is not a code audit, security review or replication.
The Saibo public crawl returned 488 accessible stars while the interface displayed 517. The 29-item gap is unresolved.
Dual-use resources require context-specific legal, ethical and security review before use.
